setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Morning, Little Schoolgirl** (1 other source): The band follows the song with a Louie Louie tease [2]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer praises inspired, exploratory guitar solos in this version [3]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Garcia's guitar work here is so intense that it is unsafe listening while driving [4]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One into Cryptical Envelopment is described as intense [12]
- **Turn on Your Lovelight** (1 review): Pigpen sings this Bobby Bland song [8]

## The recordings

- **gd69-02-02.sbd.cotsman.9758.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 9 songs; 84 min; rated 4.12/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Opening notes are clipped, with a small splice and a tiny left-channel dropout early in the song; A cut near the end of the song loses several minutes of Death Don't Have No Mercy; Soundboard has an uneven, sometimes poor mix: muddy, clipped bottom end and Garcia dominating the band [1][7][9][12][14]
- **gd1969-02-02.123283.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 86 min; rated 2.33/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: A tape flip causes a bad cut between The Eleven and Death Don't Have No Mercy [2]

## Around the show

- Garcia opens with snide remarks to the audience, then the band's tension turns into an intense performance [6]
- Tuning break includes a snide remark about Louie Louie, followed by a very brief version of it [8]
- Reviewer calls the show typical of 1969, only more so [4]
- Reviewer ranks it among the best shows of early 1969, with Dark Star, Eleven and Lovelight top-tier for the period [12]
- Show reflects the playing style the band refined on this tour for Live/Dead, before Workingman's Dead material arrived [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-02-02.sbd.cotsman.9758.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Litfin and J. Cotsman; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Transfer was normalized, pitch-corrected and cleaned of blemishes in Sound Forge; some small flaws remain [1]
- **gd1969-02-02.123283.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction on this transfer, which is improved but imperfect [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Philip Brookstein Grateful Dead: [1969-02-02 Labor Temple, Minneapolis, MN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1969-02-02-labor-temple-minneapolis-mn-usa/) [16]
